summary: Add an authorized unfiltered collection list of currently visible soft-holds (same visibility universe as get-by-id) as a full dump of LookupResponse-equivalent items including availableStock; unauthorized callers fail with UnauthorizedError under POL-OPAQUE-PRINCIPAL-AUTHZ with no mutation; extend OpenAPI (GET /reservations), UML OCL, and Vitest additively while keeping prior reserve/release/expire/lookup/concurrent Features in force and excluding list-by-SKU, filters, paging, full IAM, payments, and other prior non-goals.
goal: Authorized opaque principals can list all currently visible soft-holds in one full dump (LookupResponse-equivalent items including availableStock; empty collection OK); unauthorized callers fail with UnauthorizedError without mutating stock or holds; OpenAPI, OCL, and Vitest make the list behaviors machine-checkable without breaking prior surfaces.
background: Follow-on to done changes add-concurrent-last-unit-safety, add-lookup-available-stock, add-reservation-lookup, and initial-reservation. Callers can reserve, release, expire, and get-by-id (with availableStock) but cannot list currently visible soft-holds. Grill Q1–Q3 confirmed shared visibility, no filters, and full-dump LookupResponse-equivalent items; Q4 settled GET /reservations. Cite POL-OPAQUE-PRINCIPAL-AUTHZ; prior out_of_scope themes remain except this unfiltered collection list.

in_scope.text: WHEN an authorized opaque principal lists soft-holds THEN THE reservation service SHALL return all currently visible soft-holds in the same visibility universe as get-by-id, with no sku/status/time filter dimensions, without mutating stock or holds

WHEN an authorized list succeeds THEN THE reservation service SHALL return one full dump (no paging) whose items are LookupResponse-equivalent (holdId, sku, quantity, expiresAt, availableStock); empty collection when none are visible
IF the caller is unauthorized THEN THE reservation service SHALL fail list with UnauthorizedError and leave stock and holds unchanged (POL-OPAQUE-PRINCIPAL-AUTHZ)
Additive OpenAPI collection list at GET /reservations alongside existing POST /reservations and GET /reservations/{holdId}; do not break prior reserve/release/expire/lookup/concurrent surfaces
Module-level UML OCL with derived Vitest that make authorized full-dump list success (including empty) and UnauthorizedError on list checkable

out_of_scope.text: Multi-warehouse routing or cross-location inventory allocation
Full IAM product (SSO, OAuth UI, role admin) beyond opaque-principal authorize/deny (POL-OPAQUE-PRINCIPAL-AUTHZ)
Notifications (email, push, webhooks) about holds or expiry
Backorders, waitlists, or deferred fulfillment beyond hard-fail when stock is below request
Productizing durable shared persistence across process restarts beyond sample in-process stock and holds
Formal methods (TLA+/Alloy/other) for the list read path; concurrent safety already owns formal/
TTL extend or renewal of an existing soft-hold
List-by-SKU aggregates, sku/status/time filter query dimensions, or paging/cursor/limit-offset Means
Principal-scoped ownership, self-only listing, roles, tenants, or cross-principal admin visibility beyond shared get-by-id universe
Rewriting prior reserve/release/expire/lookup/concurrent Features beyond additive list acceptance
Latency or throughput SLIs/SLOs for list (correctness sample full dump only)

assumptions: Prior Features at requirements/reservation.feature, requirements/reservation-lookup.feature, requirements/reservation-lookup-available-stock.feature, and requirements/reservation-concurrent-safety.feature remain in force; this change does not rewrite those Scenarios beyond additive list acceptance

AuthZ for list applies POL-OPAQUE-PRINCIPAL-AUTHZ (maturity: canonical, facet: decider): opaque-principal allow/deny only; full IAM out of scope; unauthorized → UnauthorizedError; no stock/hold mutation. Policy text today names reserve/release/expire/lookup; list uses the same Means (wording harvest may follow later)
List visibility matches get-by-id: any authorized opaque principal sees all currently visible soft-holds (not self-only / ownership)
Exact success JSON envelope (bare array vs { items: [] }) is deferred to OpenAPI apply; either is acceptable; item fields are fixed
Stock and holds remain process-local / in-memory; no new persistence model
Prior Brief out_of_scope themes stay non-goals except the intentional elevation of unfiltered collection list of currently visible soft-holds; list-by-SKU / filters / paging remain deferred
constraints: OpenAPI SoT path: openapi/openapi.yaml (additive GET /reservations collection list only; do not break prior reserve/release/expire/lookup/concurrent surfaces)
UML OCL under contracts/**/*.ocl; derived Vitest under tests/contracts/**
Cite POL-OPAQUE-PRINCIPAL-AUTHZ for AuthZ on list; unauthorized must never mutate; full IAM remains out of scope
Unauthorized list failures must use UnauthorizedError shared by API, OCL, and tests
List items must be LookupResponse-equivalent including availableStock; no thinner DTO and no paging in this change
Contract kind and density choices are deferred to solidsdd-judge; this brief only requires checkable HTTP/API and module surfaces for list
ChangeBrief only at this step: no Feature files, WorkPlan, OpenAPI, OCL, tests, or implementation edits as part of brief emission
